v40Source.method: Visual review of the printed step 3 green Pi5 and blue Zero2W panels and their numbered closeups, rendered privately; no source pixels are copied into authored output

officialText.relation: Pi5 and every Zero board use the mini 22-pin connector; the cable is inserted with its metallic contacts facing away from the flap; on Zero boards the connector is on the short edge opposite the SD slot
officialText.applicability: Raspberry Pi board connector family guidance only; not SunFounder camera identity or cable metrology

commonRelation.noPinMapRouteOrCameraIdentity: No electrical pin map, cable length, bend, metric route or camera OEM identity is inferred; Q-09 and Q-10 stay unresolved

selection.rule: The Pi5 camera connector with the lower board-local X, nearest the micro HDMI ports; the other stays unused. Official guidance accepts either CAM/DISP connector, and the numeric CAM/DISP label of the chosen position is not adopted.

rpi5.v40Observation: The V40 Pi5 closeups show a top-entry connector: flap lifted (1), cable lowered vertically with the black stiffener band on the visible face (2), flap pressed down (3). Insertion is along board-local -Z.

stepSource.usage: Measured in place from the ignored vault; only derived numbers are stored here and no vendor geometry is copied or published

rpi5.interiorMarkers: The adopted Pi5 proxy has two interior camera marker blocks near X 29-45. They are not these connectors and are never used as endpoints.

selection.rule: The only camera connector, on the short edge opposite the SD slot (board-local +X end of the adopted Zero proxy).

rpi-zero-2-w.v40Observation: The V40 Zero closeups show a side-entry connector: the black slider is pulled out (1), the cable is slid in horizontally with the black stiffener band on the visible top face (2), and the slider is pressed back (3). Insertion is horizontal toward the connector and the metallic contacts face down, away from the slider and flap.

drawingSource.method: Connector outline measured on a 600 dpi raster of the official drawing, calibrated against the 30 mm board width (23.6 px/mm); uncertainty about 0.2 mm
drawingSource.usage: Measured in place from the ignored vault; only derived numbers are stored

rpi-zero-2-w.interiorMarkers: The adopted Zero proxy has one interior camera marker block near X 42-46. It is not the connector and is never used as an endpoint.

limitations: Camera connector frames are presentation endpoint frames derived from observation; the adopted board proxies contain no solid connector body at these frames and the interior camera marker blocks are not connectors

Slot height, seated depth and the contact normal are presentation approximations from the V40 closeups, the official text and measured source geometry; they are not a manufacturer dimension, fit or electrical claim
The FPC ribbon is a zero-solid schematic: only its connected end frame is defined. No route, length, bend, pin map or camera OEM identity is inferred (Q-09, Q-10)
Pi5 reference STEP and the Zero drawing are guidance sources read in place from the ignored vault; no vendor geometry or pixels are published
